the-process-in-four-steps.title: The process in four steps
the-process-in-four-steps.description: We believe getting a replacement engine should be straightforward. Here is a step-by-step walkthrough of what happens when you use Engines Market.

cards.title: Submit your enquiry
cards.text: Tell us about your vehicle and the problem. You will need:
cards.fullText: 1 Submit your enquiry Tell us about your vehicle and the problem. You will need: Vehicle registration number Current mileage Brief description of the issue The enquiry form takes about two minutes to complete. It is completely free and does not commit you to anything.

cards.title: Receive and compare quotes
cards.text: Suppliers review your details and send you a quote directly - usually by email or phone.
items: Typical time to receive quotes: Within a few hours
cards.fullText: 3 Receive and compare quotes Suppliers review your details and send you a quote directly - usually by email or phone. Typical number of quotes: 3 to 5 Typical time to receive quotes: Within a few hours You can compare prices, warranty terms, and included services side by side. All quotes come from real UK businesses, not middlemen. Based on 24,650 quote requests processed in 2025 [EM-VERIFIED], most users receive multiple competitive offers without needing to chase suppliers.

cards.title: We match you with relevant suppliers
cards.text: Once you submit your enquiry, we share it - anonymously - with specialist suppliers in our network who are a good fit for your vehicle and location.
cards.fullText: 2 We match you with relevant suppliers Once you submit your enquiry, we share it - anonymously - with specialist suppliers in our network who are a good fit for your vehicle and location. Our network includes 100+ UK engine specialists that have been onboarded against our supplier standards. Generally, they must be UK registered, have a physical business address, a minimum one-year trading history, and a public review profile averaging approximately 4.0 stars or higher. Only suppliers who can genuinely help with your engine type will receive your enquiry. We do not send leads to everyone indiscriminately.

cards.title: You choose the supplier - or walk away
cards.text: There is no pressure. You decide:
items: Which supplier to contact for more details
Whether to walk away and do nothing
cards.fullText: 4 You choose the supplier - or walk away There is no pressure. You decide: Which supplier to contact for more details Whether to accept a quote Whether to walk away and do nothing Engines Market does not choose a supplier for you. We do not take a cut of the transaction. Your relationship - including payment, warranty, and fitting - is directly with the supplier you select.

content.text: Important legal disclaimer - our role
Our role
Engines Market is a price comparison and introduction platform . We are not a garage, engine supplier, or fitting centre.

We do not sell engines. We do not hold stock. We do not fit engines. We do not provide warranties. We do not process customer payments. We do not act as a contracting party between you and any supplier.
All agreements, contracts, warranties, and payments are strictly between you and the supplier you choose. Engines Market does not mediate disputes or guarantee the performance of any supplier.
You are responsible for reviewing any supplier's quotation, warranty terms, and credentials before proceeding.
For full terms, please read our Terms & Conditions .
Why we do it this way

content.text: We exist to save you time, stress, and money by making engine replacement pricing transparent. Nothing more.
Frequently asked questions

content.question: Is the service really free- +
content.answer: Yes. You pay nothing to use Engines Market. Our income comes from suppliers who pay for qualified leads.

content.question: How do you vet suppliers- +
content.answer: Suppliers generally need a UK registered business, a physical address, at least one year of trading history, and a public review profile averaging around 4.0 stars or higher. See our full supplier standards page for details.

content.question: How long does the whole process take- +
content.answer: Most users receive quotes within a few hours. From enquiry to completed engine replacement, the average timeline (based on our 2025 data) is 5.2 days - but this varies by supplier and vehicle.

content.question: What if I do not like any of the quotes- +
content.answer: You are free to walk away. There is no obligation to accept any quote or to use our service again.

content.question: Do you guarantee the lowest price- +
content.answer: No. We provide multiple quotes from real suppliers so you can compare. The best choice depends on price, warranty, location, and your own priorities.
